text: Vale bails on Dusk for the third time, ditching the southern gate meeting to sip chamomile with Reed and Lumen at Mrs. Elara's instead. Reed and Lumen gang up gently on Vale again, saying his number-crunching is really just him grasping for something solid while the whole town feels "unmoored" — and Vale actually admits it. Flint piles on too, mocking Dusk's gloomy "cracks in the stone" warnings as unproductive, and joins the tea party instead of backing Dusk up. Dusk, stubborn as ever, heads to the empty gate alone, still insisting the town's cheerful vibes are just lavender-scented denial of something breaking underneath.
